in_latin.name: Friedrichus
in_latin.meaning: peaceful ruler, powerful king, strong in peace
in_latin.long_meaning: Friedrichus is a Latinized form of the Germanic name Frederick, derived from the elements 'frid' meaning peace and 'ric' meaning ruler. The name is associated with the virtues of peace, strength, and leadership, reflecting the values of early Christian rulers. In Christian tradition, the name Friedrichus symbolizes the union of spiritual and temporal power, reflecting the ideal of a ruler who brings peace and harmony to their people. The name has been used in various forms throughout Christian history, including in medieval Europe and in some modern Christian cultures.
